basis: each text read whole; these are the phrases a set of quotes about its inhabitants must contain. core: decides how the inhabitant stands to the place, or is the text's own answer

18728.anchor: The Mistsingers are the ghosts of the atmosphere
for they are the ones who erode
They are the kinetic energy of the rain
They are the invisible engineers of the plateau
ghosts of a civilization that decided that to be human was too heavy
They are not interested in you as an individual
They are engaged in a perpetual, glacial task

2174.anchor: among the most remarkable are the Drift Shepherds
These beings serve as caretakers and regulators
manifestations of the space itself becoming self-aware
The human workers have learned to work alongside them
regard humans with a detached curiosity
the line between the animate and inanimate
The Hydrology Priests have learned to interpret

3396.anchor: how to be part of it rather than opposed to it
The insects are the medium through which the rest of the place conducts its business
not a resident but a traveler
The moss is not one organism but a community
They have been shaped by this place over many generations

12445.anchor: It is not a physical entity but a presence
the Weavers its hands, and the Witnesses its eyes
life is not separate from the environment

6404.anchor: My body is long and low and built to be braided into stone
I keep the Gaps from becoming graves
What I am, beneath the stone, is *keeper*
They are soft creatures, living above
I don’t keep the island stable
They build their homes on it
They thought the island saved them

10214.anchor: neither wholly human nor entirely machine
grafted themselves into the very structures they inhabit
Each terrace is maintained by a guild of Symbionts

18852.anchor: not biological in any recognizable sense
they are the **acoustic residue** given form and purpose
The Custodians *are* the environment’s dynamic function
They are ghosts made of noise
They would not attack the object

6725.anchor: Alta is the woman who walks the gutters
There is no longer any clear distinction between what she is doing and what the world itself is doing
She is not exactly a worker
she looks like she’s made of the same stone and water she tends

23165.anchor: neither plant nor machine but a **symbiotic intelligence**
**The Subterranean Machinery** is the Expanse’s hidden heart
The Expanse does not host life—it *is* life

16874.anchor: the inhabitants are not inhabitants at all
I am one such concentration now
a question the mountain range is asking itself
to be the world thinking aloud
Others of my approximate kind form and dissolve
The leafless stalk-pillars are my closest companions
The migratory memory-bodies are different in kind
The difference between visitor and inhabitant here
these mountains have noticed you noticing them
